attributes.title: Level 2

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using the Assets menu to organize assets to use in your code.

questions.hint: Which asset type is used to name a tile asset from the Asset menu?
questions.title: [Select one] Which asset type is needed to access a tile asset in the JavaScript editor?
questions.correctResponse: The word “tile” is needed after the word “assets” to reference a tile from the Asset menu in your code.

questions.hint: Which line of code uses  the correct syntax to check when a sprite overlaps a tile?
questions.title: [Select one] Which line of code checks when a sprite overlaps a tile?
questions.correctResponse: In order to create an onOverlapTile event, specify the parameters inside the parentheses: the sprite kind and the tile asset name.

questions.hint: Which tool allows you to click and drag over the section of image to be resized?
questions.title: [Select one] The ___________ tool can be used to select and resize images in the Paint Editor.
questions.correctResponse: The marquee tool can be used to select the entire sprite image. Click and drag one of the corner white boxes to resize the image in the canvas. Click Done to update the asset.

questions.title: [Open response] How does changing the cursor image improve the user’s experience of your project?
questions.correctResponse: Changing the cursor image creates consistency with the assets used in the project, which can engage the user in your project.

subgroups.title: Using Assets in Code
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about using the Assets menu to organize assets to use in your code.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 2 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about tilemap overlap events and how to make different things happen when sprites overlap different tiles and walls. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 2:

badges.title: The Big Event
badges.description: Use events to control what happens to sprites navigating a tilemap in a project in JavaScript.

badges.title: Touch Controls
badges.description: Make something happen when a sprite overlaps a specific tile.

badges.title: A Chain of Reactions
badges.description: Make something happen when a sprite hits a wall.

badges.title: A Glyph in the System
badges.description: Use an image asset as a cursor image in a dialog box.

badges.title: Save for Later
badges.description: Create an array to store all of the locations of a specific tile type on a tilemap.

badges.title: Invisible Walls
badges.description: Turn a wall on or off at a specific location on a tilemap.
